_note: The release trust set for signed over-the-air rule updates (2-of-3 Ed25519). These are the current build keys shared with the desktop app (desktop/rules/trusted-keys.json); the old release-1/2/3 keys were the H6 development keys whose private halves sat beside the code, so they are permanently revoked (see REVOKED_KEYS in TrustConfig and desktop psg-core verifier.rs) and refused here even if listed. A store release replaces this file with the keys from the offline key ceremony (desktop/rules/KEY-CEREMONY.md); until then the update endpoint is blank and no over-the-air update is fetched.
